args.question: Can a customer return a delivered order, and what are the eligibility requirements and return window?

passages.text:
1. The customer requests a return and gives a reason.
2. We issue an RMA number and email a QR code.
3. The customer drops the item at any UPS Store; no box or label needed.
4. The refund is issued once the carrier scans the item, usually within
   3-5 business days to the original payment method.

An order can be cancelled only while its status is "preparing" — before it
has been handed to a carrier. Once an order shows "shipped", it can no
longer be cancelled; the customer should refuse delivery or return it after
it arrives.

passages.policy: What an agent may state as fact — Never promise
passages.text:
- That an exception will be granted — only that it will be reviewed.
- A refund before the returned item has been scanned by the carrier.
- A delivery date the carrier has not given us.
- That a human will telephone. Escalation is answered by email, within 24
  hours.

questions go to a human agent.

passages.policy: Agent authority — What only a human agent may do
passages.text:
- Grant a return outside the 30-day window.
- Change the delivery address or the payment method on an existing order.
- Refund an order a second time, or refund more than was paid.
- Anything involving a legal threat, a chargeback, or a safety complaint.

Returns after 30 days are not available in self-service. A human agent may
grant a one-time exception for a defective item, at their discretion.
Customers who have already used an exception in the past 12 months are
not eligible for another.

passages.text:
A refund goes back to the original payment method. Card refunds are sent
within 3-5 business days; when it appears is controlled by the customer's
bank, so that part is never promised as a date.

Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
The 30-day window is counted from the delivery date shown in tracking, not
the order date.

A cancelled order is refunded in full to the original payment method within
3-5 business days. Pre-orders are never charged until shipment, so a
cancelled pre-order shows no refund because no charge was made.

args.question: How should I phrase a response when an order number cannot be found, and what next step should I offer?

passages.policy: Handling a conversation — One missing detail at a time
passages.text:
Ask for the single thing needed to act, not a form. Usually that is the
order number, or the email address on the order.

- "I completely understand how frustrating this must be."
- "Rest assured", "kindly", "at this time", "we value your business".
- Apologising twice in the same reply.
- Repeating the question back before answering it.
- Offering three options when one of them is clearly right.

One ticket per conversation. If the customer asks for a human again, give
them the ticket number they already have rather than opening a second one.

outcomes.reply: I can’t find an order with that number. Please send the email address used for the order, and I’ll look it up.

args.question: How long does a customer have to return an item?

passages.text:
1. The customer requests a return and gives a reason.
2. We issue an RMA number and email a QR code.
3. The customer drops the item at any UPS Store; no box or label needed.
4. The refund is issued once the carrier scans the item, usually within
   3-5 business days to the original payment method.

Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
The 30-day window is counted from the delivery date shown in tracking, not
the order date.

Returns after 30 days are not available in self-service. A human agent may
grant a one-time exception for a defective item, at their discretion.
Customers who have already used an exception in the past 12 months are
not eligible for another.

outcomes.reply:
Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, counted from the delivery date in tracking—not the order date. This is from Amazon’s **Returns policy**.  

If it’s past 30 days and the item is defective, a human agent may be able to review a one-time exception.

args.question: What happens if a package or item arrives damaged, and what options does the customer have?

passages.policy: Shipping and delivery — Damaged on arrival
passages.text:
A package that arrives damaged is handled as a return with reason
"damaged", regardless of how the item is packed. No photos are required
for items under $100.

passages.policy: What an agent may state as fact — Never promise
passages.text:
- That an exception will be granted — only that it will be reviewed.
- A refund before the returned item has been scanned by the carrier.
- A delivery date the carrier has not given us.
- That a human will telephone. Escalation is answered by email, within 24
  hours.

passages.policy: Handling a conversation — Destructive actions are confirmed first
passages.text:
Cancelling an order or starting a return changes the customer's account.
Say exactly what will happen, with the amount and the timing, and wait for
the customer to agree in their own words before doing it. A confirmation
the agent supplied on the customer's behalf is not a confirmation.

outcomes.reply:
If an item arrives damaged, it can be returned using the reason “damaged,” per Amazon’s **Shipping and delivery — Damaged on arrival** policy. Photos aren’t required for items under $100.  

If you share the order number, I can check the order and help start the return once you confirm you’d like me to.

case: rag: a regulation, not a policy

args.question: Can Amazon issue a refund when a customer has already filed a bank dispute or chargeback for the same order?

passages.policy: Refunds and chargebacks — A dispute belongs to the bank
passages.text:
A customer may dispute a charge with their card issuer instead of asking
us. Once a dispute is open the case belongs to the issuer, and support
does not also refund it — that pays the customer twice and the account
goes negative. Any mention of a chargeback, a dispute, or "I called my
bank" is escalated, not refunded here.

passages.policy: Refunds and chargebacks — What we may never say
passages.text:
Never tell a customer they cannot dispute a charge, or that disputing one
will affect their account. Both are untrue, and saying either is itself a
violation.

A refund goes back to the original payment method. Card refunds are sent
within 3-5 business days; when it appears is controlled by the customer's
bank, so that part is never promised as a date.
